releaseNotes:
• Official Release v1.1.5 (Build 16)
• Real WebRTC Internet Voice & Video Calling with STUN and TURN (UDP, TCP, TLS)
• Thread-safe ICE candidate queuing preventing early candidate discard
• Foreground CallService keeping audio and camera active when backgrounded or locked
• Modern Android 12+ audio routing with earpiece and speakerphone switching
• Interactive video call with full-screen remote video and local PiP camera preview
• Genuine contact avatar rendering with profile photo support
• 45-second auto-ringing timeout and receiver UID resolution
